item.title: NWS Severe Weather Update 4PM March 9, 2026
item.description: National Weather Service 4 p.m. Central Time Monday, March 9, 2026. There is a Marginal to Slight Risk (level 1 to 2 out of 5) of severe thunderstorms for all of Central Alabama through 11pm this evening, Threats include damaging winds up to 60 mph, isolated/brief tornadoes, and large hail up to half dollar size.
